readerCopy.headline: You already have something solid to build on.
readerCopy.body:
Something you have been doing quietly for a long time may finally make the next step easier. The experience is already there. The routine is already working. The difficult part may be realizing that you do not need to start over to grow.

Jupiter sextile Saturn favors adding to what is already reliable. Use the system, skill, savings, or boundary that proved itself. Add one piece instead of rebuilding the whole structure because the next opportunity makes the old work look less exciting.
